verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents event-driven background automations: rule-based real-time alerts, webhooks that push data to arbitrary external services, and PagerDuty incidents created, updated and resolved automatically. Its Resolve AI agent turns a production error into a reviewable pull request. However, nothing shows that Resolve or other agentic workflows can be configured to run unattended in the background, rather than as fixed notification rules. Missing for 10: evidence that Resolve runs autonomously on triggers or a schedule, user-defined multi-step agentic automation workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
